body: **Foco:** prefer doing A to doing B — uso.

**20 palavras novas** (ciência).

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (B2):** eu consigo usar prefer doing A to doing B e would prefer numa notícia sobre ciência e explicar escolhas e usar address a concern.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.headline: Report: Students Prefer Lab Work to Lectures, Study Finds
paras: A new study shows that students **prefer working** in labs **to listening** to lectures. Many said they **would prefer to** learn by doing, and several **preferred collaborating** with classmates **to studying** alone.
The university said it would **address the concerns** by adding more lab hours. “We **want to address a concern** that lectures alone aren’t enough,” said a dean.

items.q: Students prefer studying alone to collaborating.
The university will add more lab hours.

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: Students **prefer working** in labs **to listening** to lectures.
They **would prefer to** learn by doing.

blocks.body: **prefer A to B**: use **to** (não *than*). **would prefer to** + verbo = preferência específica, educada. Evite *prefer more*.

items.s: Students prefer working in labs ___ listening to lectures. (to)
They would ___ to learn by doing. (prefer)

body: **Address a concern.** — Tratar de uma preocupação.
**Learn the ropes.** — Aprender o básico.
**Hands-on approach.** — Abordagem prática.
**Team up.** — Fazer equipe.
**Learn by heart.** — Decorar.
**Pay attention.** — Prestar atenção.
**Do you prefer labs to lectures?** — Você prefere laboratório a aula expositiva?
**Would you prefer to study alone?** — Prefere estudar sozinho?
**No, I prefer collaborating to studying alone.** — Não, prefiro colaborar a estudar sozinho.
